source_semantics.review: Individually review all nine complete files and20 hunks of the snack-bar standalone migration. Application examples and kitchen sink remove MatSnackBarModule; the annotated custom content imports exact label/actions/action directives. The example spec removes the module and the modern harness content becomes standalone with those directives, removing its declarations entry. The complete finite metadata projection retains all other array items, providers, templates, component/service methods, callbacks, expectations and cleanup; all17 source test identities and complete callback semantics remain. Do not infer DI/compiler/provider equivalence from that projection. Owned MatLegacySnackBarModule continues to declare its legacy container/simple content, import historical button/common/overlay/portal modules and provide the legacy service/default options. Its historical shared harness declares the fixture, imports the supplied module and uses the already qualified owned no-op provider. Preserve distinct legacy ownership and Material16 structure rather than transplanting modern standalone content directives or removing legacy module setup. The1028 source-member and1141 product-member guards and Cyph consumer context require no TS/API, HTML, CSS or SCSS change. Actual Angular/DI/render/floor execution is not proved by this source decision.
